claim: The verified initial dataset contains 184 formulations with complete glass-strength targets for model fitting.
Best cross-validated model was ExtraTrees with RMSE 25.92 kPa and R2 0.68.
The maximum measured value in available optimization tables was 353.29 kPa; no measured row exceeded the strict 1 MPa (=1000 kPa) target under the workbook unit labels.
283 optimization rows exceeded 100 kPa, showing high but sub-MPa adhesion in the available files.
Top de novo candidate has RF=265.9 kPa and GP=102.8±110.7 kPa.
Most influential monomer by permutation importance was Cationic-ATAC.
